name: The Darkness of Gordoth
storyline: Incomprehensible and terrifying things begin to happen in the Old Camp. The camp's inhabitants, mainly the diggers, are being brutally and mysteriously murdered. The murderer remains elusive to the guards. At the same time, one of the most powerful magnates, Oldrik, suddenly disappears. Rumors spread throughout the castle that Oldrik dabbled in dark magic. The task of finding the magnate is assigned to Anton, once the best detective in Khorinis. A dense darkness has enveloped the Valley of Mines. Could evil forces be haunting the colonies?
summary:
Frightening things begin to happen in the Old Camp. Diggers are dying in unexplained and brutal circumstances. The murderer remains elusive for the guards. At the same time, one of the most powerful barons, Oldrik, suddenly disappears. The case of finding the baron is assigned to Anton - once the best of the detectives in Khorinis. Dense darkness envelopes the Valley of Mines.

The modification offers:
- a dark plot for a few hours of fun
- new horror music and dark atmosphere
- new scripts, sounds, textures, models
- full polish dubbing
